slides.title: Numbers that stand for meaning
slides.body: An embedding turns text into a list of numbers. Texts that mean similar things get similar numbers.

slides.title: A map of your documents
slides.body: Picture a bookshop shelved by subject. A question lands next to the passages that answer it, even with no shared words.

slides.title: Bad at exact strings
slides.body: Search for part HX-4410-B and the nearest match can be HX-4410-C. Running keyword search alongside fixes it.

slides.title: Permissions don't come built in
slides.body: If the HR folder is indexed, anyone can surface it, unless access rules are checked on every search.

slides.title: Test it with real questions
slides.body: Collect a few dozen questions your team asks, with the right answers, and score every version against them.
